title: Doggy Carrier
description: Carry your best friend on your head during your adventures and let him warn you when ennemies are nearby
body:
Ever had your wolf walk straight into lava five minutes after taming it?

This mod lets you pick up your dog and carry it with you—so it actually survives your adventures.

**How it works**
----

Pick up your tamed wolf and place it on your head
While carried, it won’t wander off or get itself killed
You can safely explore caves, lava pools, and dangerous terrain

**Bonus**
----

When sitting on your head, your dog will warn you about nearby hostile mobs trying to sneak up on you.

No more surprise creepers.

**Why use this?**
----
Keeps your dog alive (finally)
Makes exploration less stressful
Adds a small but useful survival mechanic

Notes
----
Works with Minecraft 1.21.11

Future plans include rendering armor on the dog when it's on your head
